The first friend guesses 80 jelly beans. The second friend guesses 20 more than half of the first guess: half of 80 is 40, plus 20 equals 60. The third friend guesses 25% more than the first guess: 25% of 80 is 20, so 80 + 20 = 100. The average of the three guesses is (80 + 60 + 100) / 3 = 240 / 3 = 80.

Answer: 80
reasoning:
We are given: "Gunter is trying to count the jelly beans in a jar. He asks his friends how many they think are in the jar. One says 80. Another says 20 more than half the first one. A third says 25% more than the first one. What is their average guess?"

Interpretation: There are three friends. First says 80. Second says "20 more than half the first one". Half of first is 40, plus 20 = 60. Third says "25% more than the first one". 25% more of 80 is 80 + 20 = 100. So guesses: 80, 60, 100. Average = (80+60+100)/3 = 240/3 = 80. So average guess is 80. Answer: 80.
